title: Show "latest (resolves to X)" in plans and lineups
lead: *Proposed.* Where ork prints a plan or a lineup, an entry with a `requested` model shows `latest (resolves to MODEL)` in place of the model name. The lineup editor still edits the requested text, so an edit round-trips.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner, 2026-11-02: plans and lineups should say a model is the latest and what it resolves to. The resolver slice records `requested` and the resolved `model` in each lineup entry. The display sites print `entry.Model` today: `internal/cli/run.go:194`, `internal/tui/launch.go:498`, `internal/tui/lineup.go:285`, `:301`, `:312`, `internal/tui/waves.go:844`. The lineup editor fills its model field from `entry.Model` (`internal/tui/lineup.go:176`).

Design (*proposed*,): one helper `runrec.ModelLabel(e LineupEntry) string`: `latest (resolves to gpt-6.2-sol)` when `Requested` is set, else `Model`. The editor fills the field with `Requested` when set, else `Model`. The run tree and the Overview rows show the role's recorded model (the resolved name) and are not changed.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestModelLabelShowsLatestResolution` (`internal/runrec`): `{Model: "gpt-6.2-sol", Requested: "gpt-*-sol@latest"}` gives `latest (resolves to gpt-6.2-sol)`; `{Model: "opus"}` gives `opus`. Fails first: no helper.
- `TestRunPlanTextShowsLatestResolution` (`internal/cli`): `implementer: codex latest (resolves to gpt-6.2-sol) medium`.
- `TestLineupEditorShowsResolutionButEditsTheRequestedText` (`internal/tui`): the row shows the label; the editor's model field holds `gpt-*-sol@latest`.
- `TestLaunchAndWavesLineupShowLatestResolution`: the launch pane and the Waves lineup lines show the label, at 80 and 100 columns, clipped as today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Do not start before `models-latest` has landed.
2. Write the failing tests; see each fail.
3. Helper and the display sites in Files. Do not change the run tree, the Overview, or any daemon code.
4. `go test ./internal/tui -update`; review the golden diff.
5. Docs; CHANGELOG last.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).
